description:
Daily upkeep for a base. The upkeep calculator page's math: the block count walks Rust's default upkeep brackets to a blended daily
rate, and each resource's daily upkeep is what was spent building times that rate (`per_week` = 7 days).

blocks.description: Number of building blocks (foundations, walls, floors... each counts one).

wood.description: Total wood spent building the base.

name: calculate_upkeep
title: Daily upkeep for a base
